correctness.rationale: The precise object is Ind(P5 strong P5) without wraparound, on vertices indexed 5r+c. The inspected source script enumerates all 6,426 nonempty independent faces with f-vector (25,228,964,1987,1974,978,242,27,1), constructs 3,173 free-facet pairs and one critical vertex, 45 critical 3-cells, 32 critical 4-cells and two critical 5-cells, and topologically sorts every oriented Hasse incidence. The signed integer cancellation uses only unit pivots and yields exactly zero Morse boundaries. Independently enumerated all faces and computed mod-2 boundary ranks (24,204,760,1182,760,216,26,1), confirming Betti ranks 45/32/2. Integral vanishing relies on the checked complete signed unit-pivot algorithm, not mod-2 ranks. One vertex and no critical 1- or 2-cells gives 2-connectivity, then π3=Z^45 by Hurewicz. No wedge-of-spheres or higher attaching-map claim is made.

value.rationale: The first square board of width five lies just beyond the published width-two, -three and -four strong-path-product classifications. Exact integral Betti groups, a perfect Morse model and 2-connectivity give a natural width-five topological benchmark for the king hard-square complex, not an arbitrary induced subgraph or a textbook deduction. This finite exact datum can be useful to test further width recurrences; it does not purport to prove an all-width theorem.
